findings.text: follow-on: the nested-spelling compatibility reader was deleted, which changes what cached_account_budget (reckon/_backends.py:952) makes of an on-disk copy written in that spelling, from a figure to unknown with its reason. The manifest records that as an intended visible change, but no assertion in the diff pins it: the migrated tests all carry the new top-level shape (tests/test_claude_account_surface.py:84-86) and nothing feeds a nested payload to _parse_claude_account, so a re-added compat read, or a differently broken one, would not redden the suite.

follow-on: the detail string 'account answer carried no named windows' is emitted for every answer that yields no readable window, including one that does name a window whose utilisation or reset stamp is malformed and was dropped at reckon/_backends.py:841-846; the new assertion at tests/test_claude_account_surface.py:115 now pins that text, so a reader of the published reason cannot tell a shape change from a refused figure.

follow-on: the gained diff writes tests/fixtures/backends/claude-account-limits.json, tests/test_claude_account_surface.py, tests/test_cached_account_age.py, tests/test_backend_observation.py and tests/test_crew_lanes_view.py outside the node's five fenced write paths; the plan's section-8 write-path line ('the tests pinning the old account answer') does authorise them and the worker declares the expansion in follow_ons and blockers, so this is a declared expansion, not a silent one, and the coordinator must authorise it knowingly.

item_verdicts.call_sites: verified reckon/_backends.py:952 cached_account_budget and :1983 ClaudeDialect.read_account_surface reach _parse_claude_account, :2498 probe_budget reaches read_account_surface (the dialect definitions at :1210 and :1944), and probe_budget is called from reckon/budget.py:1274, reckon/crew/paid_lanes.py:923 and reckon/mcp_views.py:446; the re-keyed quota_windows is consumed by reckon/budget.py:1303 _quota_windows and by reckon/crew/paid_lanes.py:787 _probe_reading, both reading window_minutes off the row rather than the key.
item_verdicts.diff: read commit by commit against 579b78258 - 4088c6913 (fix: read one account answer shape and one timestamp parser) and 323baeda305 (docs: land the repair round in the account-read fragment) - eight files, 187 insertions and 172 deletions: _backends.py deletes the nested reader and the name-keyed windows, re-keys quota_windows by minutes and routes the reset stamp through parse_iso; the fixture and four test files are migrated to the top-level shape; the fragment records the round.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done-when is the plan's four recorded-answer bullets plus the live request, the published document after one timer pass, arms run with pytest -n 8 adding no failure, and the ruff clause; the manifest records the repaired arms (log-arm-base-focused.log 132 passed EXIT=0 at 4b43bb5e, log-arm-head-focused.log 140 passed EXIT=0 at 4088c691, no id failing in one arm only), the negative control re-applied at 4088c691 (log-negative-control.log 1 failed 7 passed EXIT=1, the failure being the all-unknown case), the head-only structural invariant (log-structural-invariant.log 2 passed EXIT=0) and log-ruff.log (three findings, all present in the base blobs, format clean, EXIT=0); the timer-pass item is recorded as the coordinator's rather than claimed.
item_verdicts.goal: the node goal is to make the claude account readable again by keeping the probe's reason, reading the endpoint that answers, and probing an all-unknown account; the gained commits are the repair round closing the prior review's four findings, and they land one answer shape (reckon/_backends.py:803 reads only the surface's own top-level windows through _live_account_windows) and one timestamp parser (:856 validates through reckon/_timestamps.parse_iso), with _nested_account_budget and CLAUDE_NESTED_ACCOUNT_WINDOW gone, so a reader can no longer be unsure which spelling is canonical.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; status complete, the literal gate command naming the head-r2 tree with -n 8, both arms' baseline_suite/after_suite JSON (exit_status 0, completed true, empty failure_ids, log paths on disk), the negative control with its quoted failure id, measurement_module reckon and measurement_cwd /tmp/reckon-crew-scratch/r-20261022T034110168470-the-claude-account-is-read-again/arms/head-r2, and follow_ons naming the expanded fence and the legacy-cache behaviour change.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the node was fenced to reckon/crew/paid_lanes.py, reckon/_backends.py, tests/test_the_claude_account_is_read_again.py, docs/evidence/fragments/a-limit-reset-reaches-every-session/the-claude-account-is-read-again.html and docs/figures/a-limit-reset-reaches-every-session/the-claude-account-is-read-again; the gained diff writes reckon/_backends.py, the fragment and the node's own test inside that list, and tests/fixtures/backends/claude-account-limits.json, tests/test_claude_account_surface.py, tests/test_cached_account_age.py, tests/test_backend_observation.py plus tests/test_crew_lanes_view.py outside it, all authorised by the plan's section-8 line and declared by the worker in follow_ons.

justifications.durability: tests/test_the_claude_account_is_read_again.py:133 asserts block["quota_windows"][300]["used_percent"] and :138 its rate_limit_type, which redden if the windows are re-keyed by name, and tests/test_structural_invariants.py:112 redden if a local fromisoformat returns to reckon/_backends.py, so the keying and parser halves of the repair are guarded, but no assertion pins the retirement of the nested reader at reckon/_backends.py:791.
justifications.evidence: the manifest's after_suite names 4088c691 with log-arm-head-focused.log recording 140 passed EXIT=0 against an exit-0 base arm, and the negative control is re-applied at that revision, but no arm re-runs the prior review's head 579b78258, so the recorded 132-to-140 delta spans both rounds rather than isolating the gained commits, and the timer-pass item stays the coordinator's.
justifications.fit: the added and rewritten definitions keep the module's strict-parse-else-unknown idiom and its mechanism-only docstrings (reckon/_backends.py:824-838), and tests/test_crew_lanes_view.py:583 derives its ISO stamp from the epoch constant rather than restating it so the two cannot drift; no plan label, version suffix, ticket reference or author attribution appears in the gained diff.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/_backends.py:806-819 picks the most-exhausted top-level window and publishes it against that window's own minutes and name, which is the one-shape account read the node goal and the plan's section-8 deliverable ask for.
justifications.reuse: the gained commit removes the duplicated parse: reckon/_backends.py:856 now validates the reset stamp through reckon/_timestamps.py:53 parse_iso, the module that owns the Z-suffix and strip handling, and the one-definition-of-the-helper invariant at tests/test_structural_invariants.py:142 holds at this head, so no added definition forks a capability the repository already owns.
justifications.scope_discipline: the gained diff writes tests/fixtures/backends/claude-account-limits.json and four migrated test files that sit outside the node's five fenced paths, authorised by the plan's section-8 write-path line and declared in the manifest's follow_ons and blockers rather than left silent.
